title: EA4LLM: A Gradient-Free Approach to Large Language Model Optimization via Evolutionary Algorithms
description_en: Full-parameter ES pretraining that uses mean next-token log-probability as fitness; demonstrated on Qwen3-style models from 0.5B to 32B parameters.
description_zh: 以真实下一 token 的平均对数概率作为适应度，使用全参数 ES 进行预训练；实验覆盖 0.5B 至 32B 参数规模的 Qwen3 风格模型。

title: Evolution Strategies at Scale: LLM Fine-Tuning Beyond Reinforcement Learning
description_en: Full-parameter, population-parallel ES that directly optimizes rewards for Countdown, math reasoning, Sudoku, conciseness, and ARC-AGI.
description_zh: 采用全参数、种群并行的 ES，直接优化 Countdown、数学推理、数独、简洁性和 ARC-AGI 等任务的奖励。

title: Hyper-ES: Effective Evolution Strategies for LLM Reasoning via Descent Direction Merging
description_en: Uses a few gradient runs to create descent directions, then applies CMA-ES to DARE-TIES layer-wise merging coefficients; evaluated on six mathematical-reasoning datasets.
description_zh: 先通过少量梯度训练获得下降方向，再使用 CMA-ES 优化 DARE-TIES 的逐层合并系数；在六个数学推理数据集上进行评测。

title: Neural Thickets: Diverse Task Experts Are Dense Around Pretrained Weights
description_en: RandOpt samples parameter perturbations, retains the best experts, and ensembles their predictions; Iterative RandOpt reaches 92.9% on GSM8K with OLMo-3-7B under the reported matched-compute setup.
description_zh: RandOpt 对参数扰动进行采样，保留表现最好的专家并集成其预测；在论文报告的等计算量设置下，Iterative RandOpt 使用 OLMo-3-7B 在 GSM8K 上达到 92.9%。

title: Quantized Evolution Strategies: High-precision Fine-tuning of Quantized LLMs at Low-precision Cost
description_en: Direct-reward ES over discrete quantized weights with error feedback and seed replay; evaluated on Countdown.
description_zh: 在离散量化权重上进行直接奖励优化，并结合误差反馈和随机种子重放；在 Countdown 上进行评测。

title: ESSAM: A Novel Competitive Evolution Strategies Approach to Reinforcement Learning for Memory Efficient LLMs Fine-Tuning
description_en: Competitive reward-based ES for memory-efficient reasoning fine-tuning, centered on GSM8K with math/code transfer evaluation.
description_zh: 面向内存高效推理微调的竞争式奖励 ES，主要在 GSM8K 上训练，并评估数学与代码任务的迁移能力。

title: Fine-Tuning Language Models to Know What They Know
description_en: ESMA directly optimizes metacognitive calibration and alignment rewards.
description_zh: ESMA 直接优化元认知校准和对齐奖励。

title: Evolutionary System 2 Reasoning: An Empirical Proof
description_en: ERO evolves model parameters toward deliberative System-2 reasoning behavior.
description_zh: ERO 通过演化模型参数，增强模型的 System 2 reasoning 能力。

title: Evolution Strategies at the Hyperscale
description_en: EGGROLL generates low-rank perturbations while retaining a high-rank population update for scalable reasoning post-training.
description_zh: EGGROLL 使用低秩扰动降低开销，同时通过种群聚合保留高秩更新，以支持可扩展的推理后训练。

title: ESSA: Evolutionary Strategies for Scalable Alignment
description_en: Evolves singular-value coordinates of LoRA adapters and supports low-precision inference; evaluated on GSM8K, PRM800K, and IFEval.
description_zh: 对 LoRA 适配器的奇异值坐标进行演化，并支持低精度推理；在 GSM8K、PRM800K 和 IFEval 上进行评测。

title: Agentic ESOpt: Fine-Tuning Long-Horizon LLM Agents with Minimal GPU Requirements
description_en: Full-parameter ES evaluates complete agent trajectories with environment rewards, giving trajectory-level parameter attribution without step-level credit assignment. Experiments include 15/45-turn Sudoku, ReAct-style Math and DocVQA, WebArena-Lite, and automatic heuristic design.
description_zh: 全参数 ES 使用环境奖励评估完整智能体轨迹，无需逐步信用分配即可获得轨迹级参数归因。实验涵盖 15/45 轮数独、ReAct 风格的数学和 DocVQA、WebArena-Lite，以及启发式算法的自动设计。

title: Understanding Evolution Strategies for LLM Reasoning: Broader Reasoning Coverage than GRPO
description_en: Explains ES's higher Pass@K through verifier-projected population diversity, contrasts it with GRPO entropy collapse, and studies sequential GRPO–ES training, functional update sparsity, forgetting, and population scaling.
description_zh: 从验证器投影后的种群多样性解释 ES 更高的 Pass@K，并将其与 GRPO 的熵坍缩进行对比；还研究了顺序式 GRPO–ES 训练、函数更新稀疏性、遗忘和种群规模扩展。

title: The Blessing of Dimensionality in LLM Fine-tuning: A Variance-Curvature Perspective
description_en: Explains why small ES populations can work in very high dimensions through low effective curvature and a rise-then-decay dynamic; studies GSM8K, ARC-C, and WinoGrande across Qwen2.5 sizes.
description_zh: 从较低的有效曲率和先升后降的训练动态解释小规模 ES 种群为何能在极高维空间中工作；实验覆盖 Qwen2.5 的多个规模以及 GSM8K、ARC-C 和 WinoGrande。

title: Matching Accuracy, Different Geometry: Evolution Strategies vs GRPO in LLM Post-Training
description_en: Compares ES and GRPO update geometry even when their reasoning accuracy is similar.
description_zh: 比较 ES 与 GRPO 在推理准确率相近时仍然存在差异的更新几何。

title: Evolutionary Strategies Lead to Catastrophic Forgetting in LLMs
description_en: Diagnoses prior-capability degradation during ES post-training.
description_zh: 分析 ES 后训练过程中模型既有能力退化的问题。

title: Overcoming Forgetting in LLM Fine-Tuning with Evolution Strategies
description_en: Reframes forgetting as performance drift and proposes anchored weight decay.
description_zh: 将遗忘重新表述为性能漂移，并提出锚定权重衰减方法。

title: Beyond the Best Guess: Improving LLM Solution Coverage with Evolution Strategies
description_en: Shows how ES affects reasoning diversity and pass@k rather than only pass@1.
description_zh: 说明 ES 不仅影响 pass@1，还会改变推理解法的多样性和 pass@k。

title: Fine-Tuning Language Models with Just Forward Passes
description_en: MeZO introduced in-place perturbation and seed replay, reaching inference-level memory for forward-only SFT.
description_zh: MeZO 引入原位参数扰动和随机种子重放，使纯前向监督微调达到与推理相当的内存占用。

title: Sparse MeZO: Less Parameters for Better Performance in Zeroth-Order LLM Fine-Tuning
description_en: Perturbs a selected coordinate subset for more efficient supervised adaptation.
description_zh: 仅扰动经过选择的一部分参数坐标，以提高监督适配效率。

title: Zeroth-Order Fine-Tuning of LLMs with Extreme Sparsity
description_en: Selects Fisher-sensitive parameters and keeps frozen weights at low precision.
description_zh: 选择 Fisher 敏感参数进行更新，并以低精度保存冻结权重。

title: Enhancing Zeroth-order Fine-tuning for Language Models with Low-rank Structures
description_en: LOZO replaces dense random directions with structured low-rank perturbations.
description_zh: LOZO 用结构化低秩扰动替代稠密随机方向。

title: Zeroth-Order Fine-Tuning of LLMs in Random Subspaces
description_en: SubZero constructs layer-wise low-rank random subspaces for forward-only adaptation.
description_zh: SubZero 构造逐层低秩随机子空间，在其中进行纯前向适配。

title: TeZO: Empowering the Low-Rankness on the Temporal Dimension in the Zeroth-Order Optimization for Fine-tuning LLMs
description_en: Exploits temporal low-rank structure shared across successive ZO estimates.
description_zh: 利用连续多个 ZO 估计之间共享的时间低秩结构。

title: RoZO: Geometry-Aware Zeroth-Order Fine-Tuning on Low-Rank Adapters for Black-Box Large Language Models
description_en: Uses tangent-space perturbations, retraction, and vector transport on the LoRA manifold.
description_zh: 在 LoRA 流形的切空间中使用扰动、回缩和向量传输。

title: ZO-Act: Efficient Zeroth-Order Fine-Tuning via One-Shot Activation-Informed Low-Rank Subspaces
description_en: Builds an activation-informed subspace once, then performs ZO SFT in that space; evaluated on language understanding, QA, and commonsense reasoning with Llama-3-8B and OPT-13B.
description_zh: 一次性构建由激活信息引导的子空间，随后在该空间中执行 ZO 监督微调；使用 Llama-3-8B 和 OPT-13B 在语言理解、问答和常识推理任务上评测。

title: SubZero+: Efficient Zeroth-Order LLM Fine-Tuning via Large Learning Rates
description_en: Combines multi-query estimation, corrected Haar subspaces, and subspace Adam.
description_zh: 结合多查询估计、修正后的 Haar 子空间和子空间 Adam。

title: Variance-reduced Zeroth-Order Methods for Fine-Tuning Language Models
description_en: MeZO-SVRG adds an anchor-based control variate to supervised ZO fine-tuning.
description_zh: MeZO-SVRG 在监督 ZO 微调中加入基于锚点的控制变量。

title: Harmony in Divergence: Towards Fast, Accurate, and Memory-efficient Zeroth-order LLM Fine-tuning
description_en: DiZO uses layer-wise projection and rescaling after analyzing FO/ZO layer divergence.
description_zh: DiZO 在分析一阶与零阶优化的逐层差异后，对 ZO 更新进行逐层投影和重缩放。

title: KerZOO: Kernel Function Informed Zeroth-Order Optimization for Accurate and Accelerated LLM Fine-Tuning
description_en: Corrects the estimator using kernel-weighted perturbations.
description_zh: 使用核函数加权扰动修正估计器。

title: Towards Fast LLM Fine-tuning through Zeroth-Order Optimization with Projected Gradient-Aligned Perturbations
description_en: P-GAP aligns low-rank perturbations with a projected gradient estimate.
description_zh: P-GAP 使低秩扰动与投影后的梯度估计方向对齐。

title: ConMeZO: Adaptive Descent-Direction Sampling for Gradient-Free Finetuning of Large Language Models
description_en: Samples directions from a cone centered on a momentum estimate.
description_zh: 从以动量估计为中心的锥形区域中采样搜索方向。

title: Low-Rank Curvature for Zeroth-Order Optimization in LLM Fine-Tuning
description_en: LOREN combines low-rank block-diagonal curvature with leave-one-out estimation.
description_zh: LOREN 将低秩分块对角曲率建模与留一估计相结合。

title: Robust and Efficient Zeroth-Order LLM Fine-Tuning via Adaptive Bayesian Subspace Optimizer
description_en: ABSO aggregates noisy subspace measurements with a Bayesian optimizer.
description_zh: ABSO 使用贝叶斯优化器聚合带噪声的子空间观测。

title: Prior-Informed Zeroth-Order Optimization with Adaptive Direction Alignment for Memory-Efficient LLM Fine-Tuning
description_en: PIZOO biases samples toward an adaptive prior direction.
description_zh: PIZOO 使采样方向偏向一个能够自适应更新的先验方向。

title: AGZO: Activation-Guided Zeroth-Order Optimization for LLM Fine-Tuning
description_en: Shapes perturbation directions with forward activations.
description_zh: 使用前向激活信息塑造扰动方向。

title: Zero-Order Optimization for LLM Fine-Tuning via Learnable Direction Sampling
description_en: ZO-LDSD learns a non-isotropic direction distribution.
description_zh: ZO-LDSD 学习一个非各向同性的方向分布。

title: Powering Up Zeroth-Order Training via Subspace Gradient Orthogonalization
description_en: ZO-Muon applies spectral orthogonalization to subspace estimates.
description_zh: ZO-Muon 对子空间估计应用谱正交化。

title: CurvZO: Adaptive Curvature-Guided Sparse Zeroth-Order Optimization for Efficient LLM Fine-Tuning
description_en: Combines curvature-aware sparse sampling with probability correction.
description_zh: 将曲率感知的稀疏采样与概率校正结合起来。

title: Learning a Zeroth-Order Optimizer for Fine-Tuning LLMs
description_en: Learns reusable model-specific perturbation strategies.
description_zh: 学习可以在同一模型上重复使用的扰动策略。

title: Second-Order Fine-Tuning without Pain for LLMs: A Hessian Informed Zeroth-Order Optimizer
description_en: HiZOO estimates diagonal curvature using forward passes.
description_zh: HiZOO 使用纯前向计算估计对角曲率。

title: Scalable Zeroth-Order Fine-Tuning for Extremely Large Language Models with Limited GPU Memory
description_en: ZO2 adds parameter offloading and execution overlap for large-model ZO SFT.
description_zh: ZO2 通过参数卸载和执行重叠支持大模型 ZO 监督微调。

title: High-Throughput and Memory-Efficient Zeroth-Order Fine-tuning LLMs with Distributed Parallel Computing
description_en: DistZO2 distributes perturbation evaluations and aggregates only scalar results.
description_zh: DistZO2 分布式执行扰动评估，并且只聚合标量结果。

title: HELENE: Hessian Layer-wise Clipping and Gradient Annealing for Accelerating Fine-tuning LLM with Zeroth-order Optimization
description_en: Adds layer-wise clipping and annealing.
description_zh: 引入逐层裁剪和退火机制。

title: QuZO: Quantized Zeroth-Order Fine-Tuning for Large Language Models
description_en: Integrates quantization into forward-only SFT.
description_zh: 将量化整合到纯前向监督微调中。

title: Hi-ZFO: Hierarchical Zeroth- and First-Order LLM Fine-Tuning via Importance-Guided Tensor Selection
description_en: Assigns FO or ZO updates according to tensor importance.
description_zh: 根据张量重要性为其分配一阶或零阶更新。
resources_zh: [论文](https://aclanthology.org/2026.findings-acl.239/) · 未找到代码 · ![Findings of ACL 2026](https://img.shields.io/badge/Findings_of_ACL-2026-orange)

title: AdaMeZO: Adam-style Zeroth-Order Optimizer for LLM Fine-tuning Without Maintaining the Moments
description_en: Approximates adaptive moments without full optimizer states.
description_zh: 无需保存完整的优化器状态即可近似自适应矩估计。

title: Beyond the Capability Boundary: Zeroth-Order Optimization for Self-Evolving LLM Agents
description_en: Perturbs LoRA parameters and scores them with answer perplexity, using the successful deep-research trajectories as SFT data to close the loop. This is multi-turn agent adaptation, but its ZO signal remains a smooth SFT-style proxy rather than a sparse terminal reward.
description_zh: 对 LoRA 参数施加扰动并使用答案困惑度进行评分，再将成功的深度研究轨迹作为监督微调数据形成闭环。该方法属于多轮智能体适配，但其 ZO 信号仍然是平滑的监督微调代理，而不是稀疏终局奖励。

title: Revisiting Zeroth-Order Optimization for Memory-Efficient LLM Fine-Tuning: A Benchmark
description_en: ZO-Bench compares objectives, trainable interfaces, and model families across representative language-understanding and generation tasks.
description_zh: ZO-Bench 在代表性的语言理解和生成任务上比较不同目标函数、可训练接口和模型系列。

title: Zeroth-Order Optimization Finds Flat Minima
description_en: Connects stochastic ZO dynamics to flat-minimum bias and includes language-model fine-tuning experiments.
description_zh: 将随机 ZO 动力学与偏向平坦极小值的隐式偏置联系起来，并包含语言模型微调实验。

title: LLM Zeroth-Order Fine-Tuning is an Inference Workload
description_en: Shows that repeated ZO scoring can be reorganized around an inference-serving runtime.
description_zh: 说明重复的 ZO 评分过程可以围绕推理服务运行时重新组织。
